name: 17sai-kyou
author: tanuki

sections.description:
Show your age on the dashboard in 「17 sai kyou」 style (always 17 years and N days).

Arbitrary section

「17歳教」のためのプラグインです。プロフィールページで生年月日を設定することで、「17歳と◯◯日」というのをダッシュボードに表示します。
sections.installation:
1. Upload 17sai-kyou to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Set the date of birth on your profile editing page.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Refactor for modern WordPress (PHP 7.4+, WP 6.0+).
  • Fix birth date save when only year or month changes.
  • Validate calendar dates and use consistent user meta APIs.
  • Improve escaping, capabilities checks, and empty-state handling.

1.0

  • Plugin Release
